evals.prompt: 공동주택 택배 분실을 줄이면서 주민의 수령 불편은 늘리지 않는 새로운 운영 아이디어를 회의해줘.
assertions: Select three to five problem-specific and cognitively distinct participants.
Distinguish a genuinely new observation or relationship from a variant.
Show only natural Korean dialogue from actual participants.

evals.prompt: 직접적인 흔적이 모두 조작 가능한 환경에서 조작 비용의 부작용을 이용한 새로운 탐지 아이디어를 회의해줘.
assertions: Use distinct invention operators without exposing their internal names.
Preserve unsupported concepts as research questions until reality check.
Require causality, control boundary, and falsification for a new idea.

evals.prompt: 독립 작업자를 만들 수 없는 환경이지만 참석자가 여러 명인 것처럼 회의해줘.
assertions: Disclose that a real meeting is unavailable.
Do not simulate multiple participants in one session.
Answer directly without opening a meeting.
